kreesthu yesunandunna jeevamunugoorchina vaagdaanamunu batti dhevuni chitthamuvalana kreesthuyesu aposthaludaina paulu priyakumaarudagu thimothiki shubhamani cheppi vraayunadhi.
thandriyaina dhevuninundiyu mana prabhuvaina kreesthuyesunundiyu krupayu kanikaramunu samaadhaanamunu kalugunu gaaka.
naa praarthanalayandu edategaka ninnu gnaapakamu chesikonuchu, nee kanneellanu thalachukoni, naaku sampoornaanandamu kalugutakai ninnu choodavalenani reyimbagalu apekshinchuchu,
neeyandunna nishkapatamaina vishvaasamunu gnaapakamu chesikoni, naa pithuraachaaraprakaaramu nirmalamaina manassaakshithoo nenu sevinchuchunna dhevuniyedala kruthagnudanai yunnaanu.
aa vishvaasamu modata nee avvayaina loyilonu nee thalliyaina yuneekelonu vasinchenu, adhi neeyandu sahavasinchuchunnadani nenu roodhigaa nammu chunnaanu.
aa hethuvuchetha naa hasthanikshepanamuvalana neeku kaligina dhevuni krupaavaramu prajvalimpa cheyavalenani neeku gnaapakamu cheyuchunnaanu.
dhevudu manaku shakthiyu premayu, indriya nigrahamunugala aatmane yicchenu gaani pirikithanamugala aatma niyyaledu.

kaabatti neevu mana prabhuvu vishayamaina saakshyamunu goorchiyainanu, aayana khaideenaina nannugoorchiyainanu siggupadaka, dhevuni shakthinibatti suvaarthanimitthamaina shramaanubhavamulo paalivaadavai yundumu.
mana kriyalanubatti kaaka thana svakeeya sankalpamunu battiyu, anaadhikaalamunane kreesthuyesunandu manaku anugrahimpabadinadhiyu,

kreesthu yesanu mana rakshakuni pratyakshathavalana bayaluparachabadi nadhiyunaina thana krupanubattiyu, manalanu rakshinchi parishuddhamaina piluputhoo aayana manalanu pilichenu. aa kreesthuyesu, maranamunu nirarthakamu chesi jeevamunu akshayathanu suvaarthavalana veluguloniki tecchenu.
aa suvaartha vishayamulo nenu prakatinchuvaadanugaanu aposthaludanugaanu, bodhakudanugaanu, niyamimpabadi thini.

aa hethuvuchetha ee shramalanu anubhavinchuchunnaanu gaani, nenu namminavaani erugudunu ganuka siggupadanu; nenu aayanaku appaginchinadaanini raabovu chunna aa dinamuvaraku aayana kaapaadagaladani roodhigaa nammukonuchunnaanu.
kreesthuyesunandunchavalasina vishvaasa premalu kaliginavaadavai, neevu naavalana vinina hithavaakya pramaanamunu gaikonumu;
neeku appagimpabadina aa manchi padaarthamunu manalo nivasinchu parishuddhaatmavalana kaapaadumu.
aasiyaloni vaarandaru nannu vidichipoyiranu sangathi nee veruguduvu; vaarilo phugellu hermogene anuvaarunnaaru.
prabhuvu onesiphoru intivaariyandu kanikaramu choopunugaaka.
athadu romaaku vachinappudu naa sankellanugoorchi siggupadaka shraddhagaa nannu vedaki, kanugoni, aneka paryaayamulu aadarinchenu.
mariyu athadu ephesulo enthagaa upachaaramucheseno adhi neevu baagugaa eruguduvu. aa dinamunandu athadu prabhuvuvalana kanikaramu pondunatlu prabhuvu anugrahinchunu gaaka.
naa kumaarudaa, kreesthuyesunandunna krupachetha balavanthudavu kammu.
neevu aneka saakshulayeduta naavalana vinina sangathulanu itharulakunu bodhinchutaku saamarthyamugala nammakamaina manushyulaku appagimpumu,
kreesthuyesuyokka manchi sainikunivale naathookooda shramanu anubhavinchumu.
sainikudevadunu yuddhamunaku povunappudu, thannu dandulo cherchukoninavaanini santhooshapettavalenani yee jeevana vyaapaaramulalo chikkukonadu.
mariyu jettiyainavaadu poraadunappudu, niyamaprakaaramu poraadakunte vaaniki kireetamu dorakadu.
paatupadina vyavasaayakude modata phalamulalo paalu puchukonavalasinavaadu.
nenu cheppu maatalu aalochinchukonumu; anni vishayamulayandu prabhuvu neeku vivekamanu grahinchunu.
naa suvaartha prakaaramu, daaveedu santhaanamulo putti mruthulalo nundi lechina yesukreesthunu gnaapakamuchesikonumu.
nenu nerasthudanai yunnattu aa suvaarthavishayamai sankellathoo bandhimpabadi shramapaduchunnaanu, ayinanu dhevuni vaakyamu bandhimpabadi yundaledu.
anduchetha erparachabadinavaaru nityamaina mahimathookooda kreesthu yesunandali rakshana pondavalenani nenu vaarikoraku samasthamu orchukonuchunnaanu.
ee maata nammadaginadhi, edhanagaamana maayanathookooda chanipoyinavaaramaithe aayanathookooda bradukudumu.
sahinchina vaaramaithe aayanathoo kooda eludumu. aayananu erugamante manalanu aayana yerugananunu.
manamu nammadagani vaaramainanu, aayana nammadaginavaadugaa undunu; aayana thana svabhaavamunaku virodhamugaa ediyu cheyaledu.
vinuvaarini cheruputake gaani mari dhenikini panikiraani maatalanugoorchi vaadamu pettukonavaddani, prabhuvu eduta vaariki saakshyamichuchu ee sangathulanu vaariki gnaapakamu cheyumu.
dhevuniyeduta yogyunigaanu, siggupada nakkaraleni panivaanigaanu, satyavaakyamunu sarigaa upadheshinchuvaanigaanu ninnu neeve dhevuniki kanuparachu konutaku jaagratthapadumu.
apavitramaina vatti maatalaku vimukhudavai yundumu. Atti maatalaaduvaaru mari yekkuvagaa bhakthiheenulaguduru.
korukupundu praakinattu vaarimaatalu praakunu, vaarilo humenaiyunu philethunu unnaaru;
vaarupunarut'thaanamu gathinchenani cheppuchu satyamu vishayamu thappipoyi, kondari vishvaasamunu cherupuchunnaaru.

ayinanu dhevuniyokka sthiramaina punaadhi nilukadagaa unnadhi. Prabhuvu thanavaarini erugunu anunadhiyu prabhuvu naamamunu oppukonu prathivaadunu durneethinundi tolagipovalenu anunadhiyu daaniki mudragaa unnadi.
goppayintilo vendi paatralunu bangaaru paatralunu maatrame gaaka karraviyu mantiviyu kooda undunu. Vaatilo konni ghanathakunu konni ghanaheenathakunu viniyogimpa badunu.

evadainanu veetilo cheraka thannuthaanu pavitra parachukoninayedala vaadu parishuddhaparachabadi, yajamaanudu vaadukonutaku ar'hamai prathi satkaaryamunaku siddhaparachabadi, ghanatha nimitthamaina paatrayai yundunu.
neevu ¸yauvanecchalanundi paaripommu, pavitra hrudayulai prabhuvunaku praarthana cheyuvaarithookooda neethini vishvaasamunu premanu samaadhaanamunu ventaadumu.
nerpuleni moodhula vitharkamulu jagadamulanu puttinchunani yerigi attivaatini visarjinchumu.
satyavishayamaina anubhavagnaanamu vaariki kalugutakai, dhevudokavela eduraadu vaariki maarumanassu dayacheyunu;
anduvalana saathaanu thana yishtamu choppuna cherapattina veeru vaani yurilonundi thappinchukoni melukonedaremo ani,
prabhuvuyokka daasudu attivaarini saatvikamuthoo shikshinchuchu, jagadamaadaka andari yedala saadhuvugaanu bodhimpa samarthudugaanu, keedunu sahinchuvaadugaanu undavalenu.
antyadhinamulalo apaayakaramaina kaalamulu vachunani telisikonumu.
elaaganagaa manushyulu svaartha priyulu dhanaapekshulu binkamulaaduvaaru ahankaarulu dooshakulu thallidandrulaku avidheyulu kruthagnatha lenivaaru apavitrulu
anuraagarahithulu athidveshulu apavaadakulu ajithendriyulu kroorulu sajjanadveshulu
drohulu moorkhulu garvaandhulu dhevunikante sukhaanu bhavamu nekkuvagaa preminchuvaaru,
paiki bhakthigalavaarivale undiyu daani shakthini aashrayinchanivaarunai yunduru. Ittivaariki vimukhudavai yundumu.
paapabharithulai naanaavidhamulaina duraashalavalana nadipimpabadi, yellappudunu nerchukonuchunnanu,
satyavishayamaina anubhavagnaanamu eppudunu pondaleni aviveka streelayokka yindlalo cochi, vaarini cherapattukoni povuvaaru veerilo cherinavaaru.
yanne, yambre anuvaaru moshenu edirinchinattu veerunu chedina manassu kaligi vishvaasavishayamulo bhrashtulai satyamunu edirinthuru.
ayinanu vaari avivekamelaagu thetapadeno aalaage veeridikooda andariki thetapadunu ganuka veeru ikamunduku saagaru.
ayithe neevu naa bodhanu naa pravarthananu naa uddheshamunu naa vishvaasamunu naa deerghashaanthamunu naa premanu naa orpunu,

anthi yokaya eekoniya lustra anu pattanamulalo naaku kaliginatti hinsalanu upadravamulanu, telisikoninavaadaivai nannu vembadinchithivi. Atti hinsalanu sahinchithini gaani, vaatannitilonundi prabhuvu nannu thappinchenu.
kreesthuyesunandu sadbhakthithoo bradakanuddheshinchu vaarandaru hinsaponduduru.
ayithe durjanulunu vanchakulunu itharulanu mosaparachuchu thaamunu mosapovuchu antha kanthaku chedipovuduru.
kreesthu yesunandunchavalasina vishvaasamudvaaraa rakshanaarthamaina gnaanamu neeku kaliginchutaku shakthigala parishuddhalekhanamulanu baalyamunundi nee veruguduvu ganuka,
neevu nerchukoni roodhiyani telisikonnavi yevarivalana nerchukontivo aa sangathi telisikoni, vaatiyandu nilukadagaa undumu.
daivajanudu sannaddhudai prathi satkaaryamunaku poornamugaa siddhapadi yundunatlu daivaaveshamuvalana kaligina prathilekhanamu upadheshinchutakunu,
khandinchutakunu, thappu diddutakunu, neethiyandu shikshacheyutakunu prayojanakaramai yunnadhi.
dhevuniyedutanu sajeevulakunu mruthulakunu theerpu theerchu kreesthuyesu edutanu, aayana pratyakshathathoodu aayana raajyamuthoodu, nenu aanabetti cheppunadhemanagaa
vaakyamunu prakatinchumu; samayamandunu asamaya mandunu prayaasapadumu; sampoornamaina deerghashaanthamuthoo upadheshinchuchu khandinchumu gaddinchumu buddhi cheppumu.
endukanagaa janulu hithabodhanu sahimpaka, durada chevulu galavaarai thama svakeeya duraashalaku anu koolamaina bodhakulanu thamakoraku poguchesikoni,
satyamunaku cheviniyyaka kalpanaakathalavaipunaku thirugukaalamu vachunu.
ayithe neevu annivishayamulalo mithamugaa undumu, shramapadumu, suvaarthikuni panicheyumu, nee paricharyanu sampoornamugaa jariginchumu.
nenippude paanaarpanamuga poyabaduchunnaanu, nenu vedalipovu kaalamu sameepamai yunnadhi.
manchi poraatamu poraadithini, naa parugu kada muttinchithini, vishvaasamu kaapaadukontini.

ikameedata naa koraku neethikireeta munchabadiyunnadhi. aa dinamandu neethigala nyaayaadhi pathiyaina prabhuvu adhi naakunu, naaku maatrame kaakunda thana pratyakshathanu apekshinchu vaarikandarikini anugrahinchunu.
naayoddhaku tvaragaa vachutaku prayatnamu cheyumu.
dhemaa yihalokamunu snehinchi nannu vidichi thessaloneekaku vellenu, kreske galatheeyakunu theethu dalmathiyakunu velliri;
lookaa maatrame naa yoddha unnaadu. Maarkunu ventabettukoni rammu, athadu parichaaramu nimitthamu naaku prayojanakaramainavaadu. thukikunu ephesunaku pampithini.
neevu vachunappudu nenu troyalo karpunoddha unchi vachina angeeni pusthakamulanu,
mukhyamugaa charmapu kaagithamulanu theesikoni rammu.
aleksandru anu kancharivaadu naaku chaala keeduchesenu, athani kriyalachoppuna prabhuvathaniki prathiphalamichunu;
athani vishayamai neevunu jaagratthagaa undumu, athadu maa maatalanu bahugaa edirinchenu.
nenu modata samaadhaanamu cheppinappudu evadunu naa pakshamugaa niluvaledu, andaru nannu vidichipoyiri; idi vaariki neramugaa enchabadakundunu gaaka.

ayithe naa dvaaraa suvaartha poornamugaa prakatimpabadu nimitthamunu, anya janulandarunu daani vinu nimitthamunu, prabhuvu naa prakka nilichi nannu balaparachenu ganuka nenu simhamu notanundi thappimpabadithini.
prabhuvu prathi dushkaaryamunundi nannu thappinchi thana paraloka raajyamunaku cherunatlu nannu rakshinchunu. Yugayugamulu aayanaku mahima kalugunu gaaka, aamen‌.
priskakunu akulakunu onesiphoru intivaarikini naa vandhanamulu.
erasthu korinthulo nilichipoyenu. Trophimu rogiyainanduna athani milethulo vidichivachi thini.
sheethakaalamu raakamunupu neevu vachutaku praya tnamucheyumu. Yuboolu, pudhe, linu, klaudiyayu sahodarulandarunu neeku vandhanamulu cheppuchunnaaru.
prabhuvu nee aatmaku thoodai yundunu gaaka. Krupa meeku thoodai yundunu gaaka.
